Our Salt Lake City refinery is helping Utah’s first charter school for students with autism strengthen its programs and raise awareness of its mission.

A refinery grant for the Spectrum Academy supported an awareness night at a local Triple-A baseball game, generating proceeds through an in-person and online auction.

Funding will also help stage a fall fundraiser for the academy, which serves more than1,500 students across seven campuses.
